title: Connect canonical mesh ejection to exact K/V ingress
hypothesis: Address-derived target control can eliminate the synthetic K/V target source and admit each filled wave atomically into K staging, score compute, and V SRAM residency.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Can one complete canonical K/V wave traverse the real transposers and produce an executable cluster command without external target metadata?
include: 4096 canonical V flits and 128 derived V block targets
real ping-pong K transpose and 64-bank wide K/Q stage
real V transpose and 2048 endpoint fill rows
atomic K-stage and externally composed score/SRAM cluster admission

service_contract.command_scope: shared across 16 clusters and eight waves of one layer/head group

remaining_abstractions: The current V transposer does not overlap fill and drain.
The full 16-cluster generated hierarchy is not yet structurally wrapped around these ingress blocks.
SRAM arrays remain inferred and the HBM controller/PHY remains external.
